description: Find an individual insurance agent on IRDAI's public Agent Locator copy. q is a licence number (zero-padded to 6 digits: 001739 not 1739), a name, an agent ID or a PIN. A licence number is fetched live from IRDAI if we do not hold it yet. Phone and mobile are masked. A miss is not proof the person is unregistered.

q.description: Licence number, name, agent ID or PIN

name: search_individual_agents
